text:
Sam: Quick poll — who moved to mesh Wi‑Fi after the WFH shuffle? dropped a pic of my new setup: https://imgur.com/A1b2C3D
Anya: Gorgeous skylight setup! what mesh did you get? thinking of switching from a single router
Sam: Got the three‑pack from Orbi, coverage is insane. setup was 20 mins, but had to move the console router location.
Micah: Heads up — mesh helped but my ISP had a 2hr outage this morning. Pro tip: keep a fallback hotspot. :grimacing:
Jordan: If you have weird dropouts try powerline adapters first — less ugly than extra APs in the living room. `sudo iwconfig` not required lol
Leo: pic: https://images.example.com/leo-desk.jpg — also cat approved. :cat2:
Anya: @Leo omg the cat knocked over your ficus? :scream_cat: put a tray under it. also love the under-desk cable raceway
Sam: also sharing a tiny script I use to monitor latency: `while true; do ping -c1 1.1.1.1; sleep 5; done` saved me during a mysterious slowdown
ops-bot: Notice: scheduled firmware update available for Orbi (1.2.3->1.2.4). Run during off hours to avoid reboots. :robot_face:
Micah: that firmware update fixed my issue last month. schedule it at night. :thumbsup:
Jordan: poll — who wants a remote meetup to swap WFH tips + cable management hacks? :raised_hands:
Anya: count me in!
Leo: I'll bring snacks (virtually).
Sam: sweet. I'll set a calendar and drop in #events. thanks everyone — great ideas and cute cat pics :heart:
